description: Locally loved and full of possibility, 1300 Vallejo Avenue sits on a sunny corner lot of approximately one-third acre just blocks from the heart of Old Town Novato. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the rare combination of an established neighborhood, walkable lifestyle, and the kind of lot size that sparks imagination.    Stroll to local shops, restaurants, community events, and downtown street fairs, then come home to a property with room to grow, create, and reimagine. Whether you're looking to restore its charm, expand its footprint, create outdoor living spaces, or explore future development opportunities, the canvas is here.    The level lot, detached structures, and generous outdoor space provide flexibility rarely found this close to downtown. Investors, builders, dreamers, and owner-occupants alike will recognize the value of securing a property where the land is just as compelling as the home itself.    Big lot. Great bones. Endless upside.    Bring your vision and discover why opportunities like this are becoming increasingly hard to find in Marin County. Offered as-is
